# P36.40 — Typeahead shards, header element and /search/ rewrite (row 381)

`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/381_P36.40__typeahead-header-element-search-rewrite.md live_verification=false`
Base: `r11/P36.39-no-js-search-results-page` · gate: none · OM-20: no · production mutations: none (`web/` only).

## Requirement stamps

- **SIG-SRCH-010** (owner) — the typeahead is an APG combobox over static per-release
  `sig.typeahead-shard/1` shards, ≤ 50 KiB per shard, no keystroke to a server.
- Cited: **SIG-UI-039**, **SIG-UI-040** (every route keeps its ADR-155 type + budget),
  **SIG-ENG-042** (over-bound shard fails the build), **SIG-UI-085** (the header element stays a
  T1 enhancement entry — the closed T2 set is unchanged), **UXR-23** (one shard set, every consumer).
- S6 carried: A-12 = a (HTML-first page types).

## What landed

- `web/src/lib/typeahead-shards.ts` — the ONE shard catalog + builder: named things only
  (places from the grouped dossier index, source registry rows, declared technology labels;
  records never enter — K3 §2.4), word-start keys, the `at`/`de`/`&` stop words, the
  three-character split for over-24 KiB buckets (`deeper` marker + bounded representative
  set), and a hard fail past the ratified 50 KiB shard bound.
- `web/src/pages/search/shards/[key].json.ts` — emits the set under `/search/shards/`; the
  data layer is release-pinned in export mode, so the set is per-release by construction.
- `typeahead-model.ts`/`sig-typeahead.ts` — `detail`/`alt` entry fields, the `deeper`
  refetch, SSR-safe import (any island bundle may register the element).
- Header element (`SiteHeader` + `BaseLayout`): the search field upgrades to the combobox
  on T1 pages via the allow-listed `/_kit/sig-typeahead.js` module; on `/search/` the island
  bundle registers it (T2 admits only `/_astro/` assets); T0 never carries it.
- Home hero + dossier-index place form consume the same shard root — the shared-shards
  rule is a failing conformance test (`tests/unit/typeahead-shards.test.ts`) on any mount
  naming a different root; the map place search (P37.19) and explorer search-to-node
  (P37.26) read the same set when their rows land.
- `/search/`: `SearchIsland` migrated React → Preact (`client:only="preact"` — `.tsx`
  resolves to BOTH installed renderers and Astro's SSR check is ambiguous while
  `@astrojs/react` coexists on `/network/`; GX-09a removes it — the P36.37 posture), a
  static reserved box in the page markup, Preact `onInput` semantics. The ≈ 66 KiB React
  runtime is gone from `/search/` — the stale `measured_gaps` `jsInitialBytes` row closed
  under the stale-row gate; `check-runtime-deps` asserts the /search/ bundle React-free.
